questions.title: Two masses on a string (double pendulum)
questions.summary: Two slotted masses hang on a string below a split cork. Changing the length x of the upper section changes the period of the swinging system; test T⁴ = Px + Q.

xlsx.desc: x and two 10-oscillation timings for six lengths. Plot T⁴ against x.

questions.title: Energy in a stretched rubber band
questions.summary: Measure a band's unstretched length and its extension under the mass hanger, then use a loading–unloading dataset to find the energy lost in one cycle (the area of the hysteresis loop), and plan how E depends on cross-sectional area and maximum load.

xlsx.desc: A practice version of datasetq2c: F and L while loading then unloading. Plot F against e and find the loop area.

questions.title: Resistance of a coil of wire
questions.summary: Estimate the length of wire wound on a tube from its diameter and the number of turns. A resistor R in parallel with the coil gives IR = GR + H, so the coil's resistance is X = H/G. Compare two coils with X = kL/d², and decide which coil gives the stronger field.

xlsx.desc: I against R for coils Y and Z. Plot IR against R; X = intercept/gradient.
